output.brief: The cancellations are mainly a Quillbook accounting-sync problem, not a price problem. Since 30 March, Quillbook's old invoice route has sometimes reported success without saving invoices, and retries sometimes post duplicates. 1,212 Quillbook accounts were affected; 34% have cancelled, against 8% of unaffected ones. Repriced accounts with no connector barely moved (1.8% to 1.9%), and Quillbook accounts on the Founders price lock rose just as much as repriced ones (1.9% to 5.9%), so the price rise is not the driver. Seasonality and the mobile release also fail to explain the pattern. Tallymarsh shows a small rise, but the cells are tiny and its logs have never been reviewed. Confidence is fairly high on the Quillbook link and the price finding; it is lower on the exact size of the sync effect and on Tallymarsh. Next: fix the Quillbook connector and contact affected accounts to correct invoices. Do not switch off the duplicate-invoice hold, since it is what stops duplicates reaching customers' books. Do not roll back prices yet, and review the Tallymarsh logs before committing to a rebuild. Track the sync fix's effect on churn.
